plan.angle: The top 10 for time slot sign up sheet template is printable grids from Pinterest, Etsy and Word or Excel template sites, plus two online tools that add appointment slots. A printed grid cannot stop the seventh name on a six-person shift or tell anyone a slot opened up. This page shows the sheet as a live booking: a capacity on every slot that closes it when full, one booking per person, a cancel link that puts the slot back, and an alert when a shift is still short. The how-to and FAQ add what printables skip: how long to make each slot, what to ask, and when to send the reminder.
tab_stories: Ottersby Food Pantry fills each Saturday shift with 6 volunteers, and when the 2 pm shift still has only 3 names on Thursday, coordinator Nerissa gets an email listing the open spots.
Professor Sylvaine offers eight 15-minute office-hour slots on Tuesday afternoons, and when Ezekiah cancels his 3:15 slot that morning, it reopens and another student books it within the hour.
Glencairn Freight runs a hiring day with 16 interview slots of 30 minutes, and at 8 am recruiter Benno gets a Slack message with the 14 booked candidates and the 2 open slots.
Tullworth Makerspace lets each member book the laser cutter for up to 2 hours a week in 1-hour blocks, so when Tancredi tries a third block on Friday the sheet tells him his weekly limit is used.
